name: Starry Ancient Link
name_jp: 極星エンシェントリンク
effects:
Master Mode, Instant ATB 1 & Diffusion Barrier 1 to user
Master Mode: Cap Break Level 2, Hero Boost +25%, Zero SB Cost 1 & Instant SB/LB Cast; If user receives MAG/MND/DEF/RES debuff, grants MAG/MND/DEF/RES +15% for 8 seconds to party (max 1 chase)
Interval Chase: 10 single-target Wind/NE, Water/NE, Fire/NE or Earth/NE magic attacks under En-Wind, En-Water, En-Fire or En-Earth, 50 SB Charge, Hero Boost +30/35/40/45/50% to user after 1/2/3/4/5 chases (max 5 chases)
Master Chase: Single-target Wind/Water/Fire/Earth/NE piercing magic attack at True Cap Break Level 1, removes Master Mode
